evaluation_components.when: As per the dates announced by IC in the Lab (workshop/IPC)

attendance_policy: Each student is expected to attend all the classes and participate in all the evaluation components.
makeup_policy: No make-up exams will be conducted for lab-based evaluation. Make-up requests for tests (Before mid-semester/ comprehensive examination) must be submitted at least one day before the exam date on the AUGSD portal only.
